_doc: S379 (operator: "on the boxing show me only what is supposed to be 100% correct"): every recorded check of a single clip or GrappleMap move, read by the ops board's Boxer animations and Grappling animations pages (ops/Tools/lean_anim_catalogue.py, lean_grapple_catalogue.py). A row with pass:true makes the clip VERIFIED and it shows on the page's default view. Only two checks may set pass:true: the operator's OK on that clip's own video, or the Argon clip judge at 9/10 or better on every score with no defect (the FIGHT9 bar, operator S371: 'until its 9/10'). Everything else (probes, a fix OK'd on stills, a lower score) is recorded with pass:false and counts as IN PROGRESS. Keys: boxing = the clip id on the Boxer page (pro_...), grapple = the GrappleMap sequence index (the Grappling page's tile id). Add a row: {check, result, pass, note, source, when}; a frame check adds frames:true and clean:true/false - the Grappling page calls a tile clean only from such a row, never from numbers alone.
bar: your OK on the clip's own video, or the Argon clip judge at 9/10+ with no defect
